Boulder Grand Remodel Celebration


Customers will enjoy huge savings from 12/3 - 12/31, plus giveaways, sweepstakes, samples and more in our refreshed space


LAKEWOOD, Colo.


, Nov. 19, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Natural Grocers](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826759-1&h=2426132436&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=Natural+Grocers) ®, the leading family-operated organic and natural grocery retailer in the U.S., is pleased to announce the Grand Remodel celebration of its Boulder store on Thursday, December 3, 2026, following a recent remodel.


Customers will enjoy the newly remodeled store at the same location, 2685 Pearl St., Boulder, CO 80302. Community members are invited to celebrate the Grand Remodel event with giveaways, fabulous savings, free samples, a prize wheel and more.


Natural Grocers' good4u® Crew will kick off the festivities at 7:45 a.m. with a $2,500 donation presentation to the[Community Food Share](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826759-1&h=3897882625&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.communityfoodshare.org%2F&a=Community+Food+Share) —its local food bank partner, followed by an official ribbon-cutting ceremony with store Crew. Doors open at 7:57 a.m., featuring exciting giveaways, sweepstakes and celebratory savings in a larger, brighter atmosphere.


"Natural Grocers has proudly served Boulder and the surrounding community since 1998," said Raquel Isely, vice president of marketing at Natural Grocers. "We're excited to give our Boulder store a fresh look and an updated shopping experience while maintaining the friendly, welcoming atmosphere our customers know and trust. This remodel reflects our continued commitment to the Boulder community and to providing high-quality natural and organic groceries, Always Affordable pricesSM and free nutrition education. We look forward to welcoming customers into the refreshed space!"


**GRAND REMODEL EVENTS – FREEBIES, DISCOUNTS & SWEEPSTAKES**
The Grand Remodel celebration at Natural Grocers' Boulder location will offer the community hands-on fun, surprises and exciting deals starting December 3.


- **December 3:** Mystery Gift Cards for the first 150 customers – Be among the first in line and receive a Natural Grocers mystery gift card (values range from $5 to $500)!\[i\]
- **December 3:** Free Natural Grocers Hand-Crafted Ecuadorian Drawstring Backpack Bag ($30 value) – The first 500 shoppers will receive a unique, hand-crafted drawstring backpack, woven by artisans in Peguche, Ecuador.\[ii\]
- **December 3:** Prize Wheel – Spin the Natural Grocers prize wheel between 12 p.m. and 5 p.m. for a chance to win great prizes.\[iii\]
- **December 3–17:** Grand Remodel Sweepstakes – Customers have the chance to win fabulous prizes, including an Aventon e-bike (valued at $1,400), a $500 Natural Grocers gift card and more. Entry forms will be available at the store.\[iv\]
- **December 3–31:** Save up to 50% off premium-quality products from every department, including Bagged Organic Fuji Apples ($4.69/2-lb bag), Nixie® Organic Sparkling Flavored Water ($4.99/pack), GT's Synergy Kombucha ($2.79/ea), Everyone® Select 3-in-1 Soaps ($10.99/ea), and Ancient Nutrition Once Daily Multivitamins ($18.49/ea).\[v\]


**{N}POWER** **®** **MEMBERSHIP**
For even more savings, customers can join {N}power, Natural Grocers' free rewards program for Even More Affordable PricesSM, digital coupons, rewards benefits and other members-only features.


- **December 3-31:** {N}power *®* members will receive exclusive pricing on items such as Contented Hen *®* Select Free-Range Eggs ($1.99 each), Mary's *®* Non-GMO Whole Chicken ($9.99/each), USDA-certified organic avocados (.99¢ each, limit three), and Kerrygold Irish Butter Sticks ($4.99/8 oz, limit one).\[vi\]


Not an {N}power member? Customers can join at the store or[download and sign into the free App](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826759-1&h=543048648&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fnatural-grocers-app&a=download+and+sign+into+the+free+App) . Customers can also join {N}power by visiting[naturalgrocers.com/npower](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826759-1&h=1568961065&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fnpower&a=naturalgrocers.com%2Fnpower) .\[vii\]


**WHAT'S NEW?**


With a fresh, more spacious layout and thoughtful upgrades throughout, the remodeled Boulder store offers an improved shopping experience with more to explore. From expanded departments and an enhanced checkout experience to sustainable building features and more space for 100% organic produce, customers will find plenty of exciting improvements while still enjoying the friendly, welcoming atmosphere they know and love.


- **100% Organic Produce for Days:** Natural Grocers, a champion of organic produce, is proud to offer a more spacious and extensive selection of 100% USDA certified organic produce at the remodeled store. From apples to zucchini, every piece of produce avoids cross-contamination with conventional/GMO items while in our stores and is grown without synthetic pesticides.
- **A Nutrition Education Center:** The remodeled store features a refreshed space designed to educate, engage and empower customers through Nutrition Education classes, recipe demonstrations and more.[The space can also be reserved](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826759-1&h=1620396615&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fmeeting-space-reservations&a=The+space+can+also+be+reserved) for group activities and guest presentations.
- **Gorgeous Body Care and Beauty Expansion:** Customers can explore an expanded Body Care and Beauty Department, featuring natural, innovative and ethical products that deliver results without compromise. All products meet[Natural Grocers' high body care standards](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826759-1&h=3543311885&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fstandards%2Fbody-care-standards&a=Natural+Grocers%27+high+body+care+standards) .
- **A Super-Sized Supplement Department:** Natural Grocers is known for offering the widest selection of premium-quality supplements in town, and the Boulder store now has even more to explore, with more than 6,000 SKUs.
- **A Modernized Checkout Queue:** Never choose the wrong checkout line again! The updated checkout queue is designed to make checking out more efficient, helping customers wrap up their shopping trips with less hassle.
- **Going Even Greener:** Natural Grocers continues its commitment to sustainable building practices with upgrades that include 100% LED lighting for a lighter carbon footprint.
- **More Options Storewide:** Customers will find even more products throughout the remodeled store, with expanded space to fill and an even greater selection of good4uSM groceries.


**WHAT STAYS THE SAME?**


Serving customers with a wide range of natural and organic options since 1955, Natural Grocers will continue to support the community with world-class customer service from its knowledgeable and friendly good4u Crew, plus:


- **Environmentally Thoughtful Products and Practices:** From checkouts free from single-use bags, to organic, non-GMO and Always Affordable Natural Grocers brand products and ecologically thoughtful in-store features, the company focuses on a mutually beneficial relationship with nature.
- **Premium-Quality Products at an Always Affordable Price** : Access high-quality organic and natural groceries including 100% pasture-raised eggs and dairy, 100% non-GMO prepackaged bulk goods, and household essentials at an Always Affordable Price. Natural Grocers also prioritizes humanely sourced and sustainably raised meats.
- **A Commitment to Crew:** Natural Grocers is passionate about ensuring that its employees can live a healthy, balanced life. The company is committed to positively impacting Crew members' physical, emotional and financial well-being with free nutrition education programs, excellent benefits and access to the highest quality, affordably priced products.

**ABOUT NATURAL GROCERS BY VITAMIN COTTAGE** Founded in 1955, Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage, Inc. (NYSE:[NGVC](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826759-1&h=1495970664&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=NGVC) ) is an expanding specialty retailer of natural and organic groceries, body care products and dietary supplements. The grocery products sold by Natural Grocers must meet strict quality guidelines and may not contain artificial flavors, preservatives or sweeteners (as defined by its standards), synthetic colors or partially hydrogenated or hydrogenated oils. The Company sells only USDA-certified organic produce and exclusively pasture-raised, non-confinement dairy products and free-range eggs. Natural Grocers' flexible smaller-store format allows it to offer affordable prices in a shopper-friendly, clean and convenient retail environment. The Company also provides extensive free science-based Nutrition Education programs to help customers and Crew make informed health and nutrition choices. Natural Grocers is committed to its[Five Founding Principles](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826759-1&h=3384226279&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Four-five-founding-principles&a=Five+Founding+Principles) —including its "Commitment to Community" and "Commitment to Crew." In fiscal year 2025, the Company invested more than $16 million in incremental compensation and discretionary payments for Crew. Headquartered in Lakewood, CO, Natural Grocers has 175 stores in 22 states. Visit[naturalgrocers.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826759-1&h=1691790487&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=naturalgrocers.com%C2%A0) for more information and store locations.
